observations.behavior: Replaces broad select_related on User and Team with explicit, column-limited Prefetch queries.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces database row size and prevents N+1 or correlated subqueries when listing many tasks; relevant to PostHog's backend performance and warehouse ingestion paths.

observations.code_quote: return {run.task_id: run for run in runs}
observations.behavior: Changes retrieval of TaskRun records from a pre-fetched ID set to an ordered, distinct-by-task_id batch fetch.
observations.posthog_connection: Eliminates the previous pattern that could have produced multiple rows per task (N+1); this is a systemic reliability improvement across all list endpoints using these helpers.

observations.behavior: Adds PostgreSQL DISTINCT ON clause while removing the scalar subquery used to compute latest-run-id.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides test-backed evidence that the query plan changed as intended; without this change, every task row would carry its own subquery, increasing load and latency.
